verdict.rationale: No documented web search endpoint returns full page content for its results. The closest match is the Answers endpoint, which researches a question on the live web and returns JSON with source URLs. That means a query in one call, but you get synthesized data plus links, not the full content of each result page. Getting full Markdown otherwise means scraping or crawling known URLs in separate calls. Missing for 10: a search endpoint that returns full Markdown/HTML content per result in one call, docs on result count and content formats, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
